programme.desc: Quirky Eggheads. After Dr. Sturgis experiences a nervous breakdown, Mary worries Sheldon is headed down a similar path. Georgie finds he has a knack for sales. S3, Ep1

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Broom Closet. Without Dr. Sturgis's university class, Sheldon takes his education into his own hands. Mary helps Pastor Jeff avoid temptation with his girlfriend. S3, Ep2

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Classified Material Turbulence. Stuart asks Leonard's advice for a date with Penny. Wolowitz realises there's an error in a toilet he designed for the International Space Station. S2, Ep22

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Monopolar Expedition. The guys receive a prestigious offer to work over the summer at the North Pole, and Penny's resultant behaviour leaves Leonard unsure if he should go. S2, Ep23

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Electric Can Opener. Discovering Leonard, Raj and Howard fudged the results of his Arctic research expedition, a disgraced Sheldon heads home to Texas. S3, Ep1

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Jiminy Conjecture. Sheldon and Howard wager comic books over a cricket's species. Meanwhile, a less-than-perfect romantic night agonizes Leonard and Penny. S3, Ep2

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Gothowitz Deviation. Howard takes Raj along to check out the Goth dating scene. Sheldon uses chocolate as part of a behaviour modification experiment on Penny. S3, Ep3

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Pirate Solution. Facing a return to India, Raj needs a job desperately enough to consider working for Sheldon. Howard becomes a third wheel to Leonard and Penny. S3, Ep4

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Creepy Candy Coating Corollary. Sheldon looks forward to squaring off against a Star Trek actor in a fantasy card game tournament. Wolowitz cashes in on an old pact with Leonard. S3, Ep5

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Cornhusker Vortex. Hoping to fit in with Penny's football-loving friends, Leonard gets tutored in the sport by Sheldon. Raj is furious over the loss of his patang. S3, Ep6

programme.title: New: One Day In My Body
programme.desc: The Halo Effect. Lukas has Parry-Romberg Syndrome, causing half his face to shrink inward. Steffni's rare muscular dystrophy leaves her dependent on her mother. S1, Ep3

programme.title: New: One Day In My Body
programme.desc: Fading Confetti. An allergic reaction left Kirtus with vitiligo, alopecia, and bone loss. Portia's rare skin condition may exist in fewer than 25 people worldwide. S1, Ep4
